item.title: The 'Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen' post is misleading
item.description:
📝 There’s experiments that look at raw weights, and experiments that improve a game-playing network, and an experiment that improves Qwen at maths. #ExperimentSizeReads raw weights. But to me the Qwen result and the other experiments that use Python don’t belong in the same post or paper as the experiments that read the weights directly.
🔗 Read more: https://honnibal.dev/blog/astra-read-write-misleading

item.title: Charles Tandy, the mastermind behind Radio Shack
item.description:
📝 Early lifeCharles Tandy was instrumental in creating three retail empires: Tandy Leather, Pier 1 Imports, and Radio Shack. Tandy developed his small family leather business into an international corporation. Hinckley and Tandy split in 1950, with Hinckley taking the part of the business that sold shoe findings, and Tandy taking the leathercraft business.
🔗 Read more: https://dfarq.homeip.net/charles-tandy-the-mastermind-behind-radio-shack/
